selection_rule: Final 40k FID must be lower than EXP-1 on both paired selection seeds, separately per NFE.
confirmation_rule: For each eligible NFE, final 40k FID must be lower on all four paired confirmation seeds; otherwise inconclusive.
training_time_rationale: 19.112 optimizer hours from measured 1.7201 s/update; 1.284 h conservative overhead reference (twice historical non-update job time), plus 1.604 h allowance for timing uncertainty and bounded recovery; 22 h is a watchdog, not a new default or a changed 40k schedule.
evaluation_time_rationale: At most 32 primary passes; 75.32 s/pass reference gives 40.2 min, with a 50 min cumulative evaluation allowance including startup/recovery.
